name: Mild Steel (AISI 1018 / IS 2062)
description: Low-carbon structural steel with excellent weldability and machinability. Exhibiting a distinct upper and lower yield point followed by a prominent yield plateau and cup-and-cone ductile fracture.
applications: Structural construction, automotive frames, machine components, shafts, fasteners.

name: Aluminium Alloy (6061-T6)
description: Precipitation-hardened aluminium alloy with magnesium and silicon. Lacks a sharp yield point; exhibits continuous yielding requiring a 0.2% offset proof stress convention.
applications: Aerospace structural fittings, marine vessels, bicycle frames, high-precision machining fixtures.

name: Electrolytic Copper (C11000 ETP)
description: High-purity electrolytic tough pitch copper known for exceptional electrical and thermal conductivity combined with superb ductility and significant work hardening capability.
applications: Electrical busbars, windings, gaskets, heat exchangers, architectural cladding.

name: Cartridge Brass (C26000 / 70-30)
description: Single-phase alpha brass containing approximately 70% copper and 30% zinc. Possesses the highest ductility among copper-zinc alloys, enabling severe deep drawing operations.
applications: Ammunition cartridge cases, plumbing fixtures, radiator cores, musical instruments.

name: Stainless Steel (AISI 304 / 1.4301)
description: Austenitic chromium-nickel stainless steel. Shows no definite yield point, extreme work hardening rate, high toughness even at cryogenic temperatures, and outstanding corrosion resistance.
applications: Chemical processing vessels, food processing equipment, surgical tools, architectural trim.

name: Titanium Alloy (Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5)
description: Alpha-beta titanium alloy combining high specific strength (strength-to-weight ratio), exceptional fracture toughness, biocompatibility, and high corrosion resistance.
applications: Aerospace airframe and turbine blades, biomedical orthopedic implants, offshore marine hardware.
